An '''iron boots''' is the [[Iron equipment|iron]] [[Armor#Boots|boots]], crafted from [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. It gives 2 armor and has 350 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/iron_boots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which gives the item the stats listed below.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/iron/boots</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 2 armor. The vanilla item gives 2 armor with 195 durability.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/iron_ingot_from_blasting_iron_materials.json}}</ref>
